([[Lexington, Kentucky]]) | college = [[Western Kentucky Hilltoppers basketball|Western Kentucky]] (2017–2021) | draft_year = 2021 | career_start = 2021 | years1 = 2021–2022 | team1 = [[Traiskirchen Lions]] | years2 = 2022–2023 | team2 = [[KK Dubrava]] | years3 = 2023–present | team3 = [[AEK Larnaca B.C.|AEK Larnaca]] | highlights = *[[Cyprus Basketball Division 1|Cypriot League]] champion (2023, 2025) * [[Cypriot Basketball Cup|Cypriot Cup]] winner (2023) * [[Cypriot Basketball Super Cup|Cypriot Super Cup]] winner (2025) * [[Cypriot Basketball Super Cup|Cypriot Super Cup]] MVP (2025) * [[Cyprus Basketball Division 1|Cypriot League]] All-Star (2023) * First-team All-[[Conference USA]] (2020) * Second-team All-Conference USA (2021) * Third-team All-Conference USA (2019) * Conference USA All-Freshman Team (2018) * [[Kentucky Mr. Basketball]] (2017) }} '''Taveion Hollingsworth''' (born August 14, 1998) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[AEK Larnaca B.C.|AEK Larnaca]] of the [[Cypriot Basketball League|Cypriot League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Western Kentucky Hilltoppers basketball|Western Kentucky Hilltoppers]]. ==Early life and high school career== Hollingsworth grew up in [[Pontiac, Michigan]] and started playing basketball at age six. In second grade, he moved with his family to [[Lexington, Kentucky]].{{cite web |last1=Bishop |first1=Chad |title=On pace to become one of the highest-scoring freshmen in WKU history, Hollingsworth plays for more on and off the court |url=https://www.wbko.com/content/news/On-pace-to-become-one-of-the-highest-scoring-freshmen-in-WKU-history-Hollingsworth-plays-for-more-on-and-off-the-court-468138143.html |website=[[WBKO]] |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=January 5, 2018}} He attended [[Paul Laurence Dunbar High School (Lexington, Kentucky)|Paul Laurence Dunbar High School]] in Lexington. As a junior, he led his team to its first state championship, scoring 20 points in the title game and earning tournament [[most valuable player]] honors.{{cite web |title=Paul Dunbar wins first-ever state basketball title |url=https://www.kentuckynewera.com/sports/article_7a137824-ef22-11e5-8c77-f36af83828a0.html |website=[[Kentucky New Era]] |publisher=[[The Associated Press]] |access-date=November 27, 2020 |date=March 20, 2016}} Hollingsworth averaged 28.3 points, 6.8 rebounds, 3.9 assists and 3.1 steals per game as senior. He was named [[Kentucky Mr. Basketball]] and Kentucky [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade Player of the Year]].{{cite web |last1=Moore |first1=Josh |title=Taveion Hollingsworth named Kentucky Gatorade Boys' Basketball Player of the Year |url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/high-school/prep-basketball/article139707143.html |website=[[Lexington Herald-Leader]] |access-date=November 27, 2020 |date=March 20, 2017}}{{cite web |title=Hilltopper signee Hollingsworth named 2017 Kentucky Mr. Basketball |url=https://www.bgdailynews.com/sports/wku/hilltopper-signee-hollingsworth-named-2017-kentucky-mr-basketball/article_a82d30f6-436d-55bf-9d62-eac3e63eda06.html |website=[[The Daily News (Kentucky)|The Daily News]] |access-date=November 27, 2020 |date=March 24, 2017}} A three-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], he committed to playing college basketball for [[Western Kentucky Hilltoppers basketball|Western Kentucky]] over an offer from [[UAB Blazers men's basketball|UAB]].{{cite web |last1=Stephens |first1=Brad |title=In-state Class of '17 guard Hollingsworth commits to WKU |url=https://www.bgdailynews.com/sports/wku/in-state-class-of-guard-hollingsworth-commits-to-wku/article_ced80d3a-194b-5ecb-be6c-c6c3aea8ab5c.html |website=[[The Daily News (Kentucky)|The Daily News]] |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=November 9, 2016}} He had also received a conditional scholarship offer from [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]].{{cite web |last1=Story |first1=Mark |title=Thriving at WKU, Hollingsworth has no regrets about UK |url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/spt-columns-blogs/mark-story/article201630349.html |website=[[Lexington Herald-Leader]] |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=February 22, 2018}} ==College career== On February 15, 2018, Hollingsworth scored a freshman season-high 30 points, the most by a Western Kentucky freshman since 1955,{{cite web |last1=Stephens |first1=Brad |title='Sky's the limit' for Hollingsworth after remarkable freshman year |url=https://www.bgdailynews.com/sports/wku/skys-the-limit-for-hollingsworth-after-remarkable-freshman-year/article_2f70da0f-58f5-59c0-bba1-864528f29f11.html |website=[[The Daily News (Kentucky)|The Daily News]] |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=March 31, 2018}} and grabbed seven rebounds in a 102–94 overtime win over [[North Texas Mean Green men's basketball|North Texas]].{{cite web |title=Hilltoppers Ride Hollingsworth, Free Throws to Overtime Win at North Texas |url=https://wkusports.com/news/2018/2/15/mens-basketball-hilltoppers-ride-hollingsworth-free-throws-to-overtime-win-at-north-texas.aspx |website=Western Kentucky University Athletics |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=February 15, 2018}} On March 21, he scored 30 points for a second time with eight rebounds in a 92–84 quarterfinal win over [[Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball|Oklahoma State]] at the [[2018 National Invitation Tournament]].{{cite web |title=Hollingsworth leads Western Kentucky past Oklahoma State into NIT semis |url=https://www.wymt.com/content/sports/Hollingsworth-leads-W-Kentucky-past-Okla-St-into-NIT-semis-477585603.html |website=[[WYMT-TV]] |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=March 21, 2018}} As a freshman, Hollingsworth averaged 13.3 points, 3.4 rebounds and 1.9 assists per game despite playing several games with a broken nose. He earned [[Conference USA]] All-Freshman Team honors and surpassed [[Courtney Lee]] for Western Kentucky's freshman scoring record.{{cite web |last1=Stephens |first1=Brad |title=Hollingsworth breaks Lee's WKU freshman scoring record |url=https://www.bgdailynews.com/sports/wku/hollingsworth-breaks-lees-wku-freshman-scoring-record/article_ff9e4cd7-f53f-5212-882e-69cc6f1e2f07.html |website=[[The Daily News (Kentucky)|The Daily News]] |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=March 14, 2018}} Hollingsworth was suspended from an [[exhibition game]] prior to his sophomore season for a violation of team rules, after being cited for [[Cannabis (drug)|marijuana]] possession.{{cite web |title=WKU's Taveion Hollingsworth cited for marijuana possession |url=https://www.wbko.com/content/news/WKUs-Taveion-Hollingsworth-cited-for-marijuana-possession-499321221.html |website=[[WBKO]] |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=November 1, 2018}} As a sophomore, he averaged 14.4 points, 4.4 rebounds and 2.2 assists per game. He was named to the Third Team All-Conference USA as well as the All-Tournament Team.{{cite web |title=Hilltoppers Picked to Win League; Hollingsworth, Bassey Named to Preseason Team |url=https://wkusports.com/news/2019/10/17/mens-basketball-hilltoppers-picked-to-win-league-hollingsworth-bassey-named-to-preseason-team.aspx |website=Western Kentucky University Athletics |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=October 17, 2019}} On February 27, 2020, Hollingsworth posted a career-high 43 points, six rebounds and three assists in a 95–91 overtime win over [[Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball|Louisiana Tech]]. He scored the most single-game points by a Western Kentucky player since [[Jim McDaniels]] in 1971.{{cite web |last1=Wells |first1=Elliott |title=Taveion Hollingsworth's career-high 43 points sends WKU past Louisiana Tech in overtime classic |url=https://wkuherald.com/sports/taveion-hollingsworths-career-high-43-points-sends-wku-past-louisiana-tech-in-overtime-classic/article_7d4b0b16-59e4-11ea-ae5f-77bb01eb59a5.html |website=[[College Heights Herald]] |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=February 27, 2020}} Five days later, he was named Oscar Robertson National Player of the Week.{{cite web |title=Hollingsworth Named USBWA National Player of the Week |url=https://wkusports.com/news/2020/3/3/mens-basketball-hollingsworth-named-usbwa-national-player-of-the-week.aspx |website=Western Kentucky University Athletics |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=March 3, 2020}} As a junior, Hollingsworth averaged 16.6 points, 4.2 rebounds and 2.7 assists per game, earning First Team All-Conference USA honors.{{cite web |title=Tops Picked as C-USA Favorite; Hollingsworth, Bassey Named to Preseason Team |url=https://wkusports.com/news/2020/11/2/mens-basketball-tops-picked-as-c-usa-favorite-hollingsworth-bassey-named-to-preseason-team |website=Western Kentucky University Athletics |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=November 5, 2020}} He averaged 13.9 points, 3.8 rebounds and 2.4 assists per game as a senior and was named to the Second Team All-Conference USA. Hollingsworth announced he was turning professional rather than use the fifth year of eligibility granted due to the COVID-19 pandemic. He finished his career fifth on Western Kentucky's all-time scoring list with 1,896 points, set the school record with 131 games started, and ranked in the top 10 in career steals, free throws made, free throws attempted and free-throw percentage.{{cite web |title=Hollingsworth Set to Begin Professional Basketball Career |url=https://wkusports.com/news/2021/5/10/hollingsworth-set-to-begin-professional-basketball-career.aspx |website=[[Western Kentucky Hilltoppers]] |access-date=August 29, 2021 |date=May 10, 2021}} ==Professional career== On August 6, 2021, Hollingsworth signed his first professional contract with the [[Traiskirchen Lions]] of the [[Austrian Basketball Superliga]].{{cite web |title=Arkadia tabs rookie Taveion Hollingsworth |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Austria/news/698294/Arkadia-tabs-rookie-Taveion-Hollingsworth |website=Eurobasket |access-date=August 29, 2021 |date=August 6, 2021}} He subsequently joined [[KK Dubrava]] of the Croatian league and averaged 19.2 points, 6.2 rebounds, and 3.5 assists per game. On February 23, 2023, Hollingsworth signed with [[AEK Larnaca B.C.]] of the [[Cyprus Basketball Division A]].{{cite web |title=Taveion Hollingsworth (ex Dubrava) agreed terms with AEK Larnaca |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Croatia/news/794830/Taveion-Hollingsworth-(ex-Dubrava)-agreed-terms-with-AEK-Larnaca |website=Eurobasket |access-date=February 23, 2023 |date=February 23, 2023}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2017–18 Western Kentucky Hilltoppers basketball team|Western Kentucky]] | '''38''' || '''37''' || 34.5 || '''.480''' || '''.378''' || .791 || 3.4 || 1.9 || 1.0 || .1 || 13.3 |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2018–19 Western Kentucky Hilltoppers basketball team|Western Kentucky]] | 34 || 34 || '''36.8''' || .418 || .318 || .771 || '''4.4''' || 2.2 || 1.2 || '''.2''' || 14.4 |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2019–20 Western Kentucky Hilltoppers basketball team|Western Kentucky]] | 30 || 30 || 34.9 || .471 || .308 || .843 || 4.2 || '''2.7''' || '''1.3''' || .1 || '''16.6''' |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 Western Kentucky Hilltoppers basketball team|Western Kentucky]] | 29 || 29 || 31.4 || .421 || .329 || '''.859''' || 3.8 || 2.4 || 1.2 || '''.2''' || 13.9 |- class="sortbottom" | style="text-align:center;" colspan="2"| Career | 131 || 130 || 34.5 || .447 || .336 || .818 || 3.9 || 2.3 || 1.2 || .2 || 14.5 {{S-end}} ==Personal life== Hollingsworth is the son of Kathy Sweatt and Maurice Hollingsworth. Both of his parents were standout basketball players at Harlan High School in [[Harlan, Kentucky]]. He has a daughter, Aubrey, who was born in 2017.{{cite web |last1=Estes |first1=Gentry |title=Taveion Hollingsworth a shooting star at WKU, one that got away for UK |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/kentuckiana/2018/12/31/taveion-hollingsworth-stars-wku-basketball-kentucky-basketball/2267253002/ |website=[[The Courier-Journal]] |access-date=December 2, 2020 |date=December 31, 2018}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://wkusports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/taveion-hollingsworth/2395 Western Kentucky Hilltoppers bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Hollingsworth, Taveion}} [[Category:1998 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Lexington, Kentucky]] [[Category:Basketball players from Pontiac, Michigan]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Traiskirchen Lions players]] [[Category:Western Kentucky Hilltoppers basketball players]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:KK Dubrava players]] [[Category:AEK Larnaca B.C. players]]
